A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Veterinary Radiologist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.



*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***


This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to LinkedIn messages sent to arrange interviews.


Please ensure that you check your LinkedIn messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.


We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.

title: English Teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Emerging Market Trader em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.) on markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior IT Technical Recruiter – LATAM Based
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior IT Technical Recruiter – LATAM Based em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Aptonet Inc. is seeking experienced Senior IT Technical Recruiters to join our world-class recruiting team. This role is based in Latin America (LATAM) and will focus on sourcing, screening, and placing top technical talent. You will recruit LATAM-based candidates for U.S.-based companies and also support U.S.-based recruiting efforts for our U.S. clients.

Our recruiting team builds the foundation of our clients’ success by connecting them with extraordinary talent who share our vision and values.


What We Look For

  • 3-5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in an agency setting or a high-growth tech environment .
  • Proven experience recruiting for diverse Information Technology roles .
  • Understanding of technology trends and a passion for working with technical professionals.
  • Strong ability to multi-task , manage multiple roles, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills – both written and verbal – in English; Spanish and/or Portuguese is a plus.
  • High level of professionalism, integrity, and customer service focus.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook , and modern ATS systems.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Manage the end-to-end recruitment process , including sourcing, screening, interviews, feedback, offers, and onboarding.
  • Build strong pipelines of both LATAM and U.S.-based technical candidates using creative sourcing strategies.
  • Leverage a variety of sourcing tools, including internet research, Boolean search strings, LinkedIn, ATS mining, and cold calling .
  • Evaluate applicants by comparing qualifications to job requirements and conducting initial screening interviews.
  • Post job advertisements across relevant platforms such as LinkedIn, Dice, CareerBuilder , and niche tech sites.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers and internal teams to understand role requirements and deliver top candidates quickly.
  • Maintain data accuracy in the ATS and track recruiting metrics for reporting and continuous improvement.
  • Develop scalable recruiting processes to support the growth of our recruiting operations in LATAM and the U.S.
  • Act as a trusted representative of Aptonet , promoting our values and delivering a high-quality experience to both candidates and clients.

Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Arquiteto de soluções (Pre-Vendas)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto de soluções (Pre-Vendas) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Buscamos um profissional para reforçar o time de pré-vendas, atuando como elo entre cliente, time comercial e áreas técnicas. O perfil ideal combina bagagem consultiva, fluência técnica e capacidade de transformar problemas de negócio em soluções estruturadas, com velocidade na construção de materiais e energia para conduzir conversas estratégicas em ambiente client facing.


Atividades:

  • Apoiar o time comercial em oportunidades de pré-vendas, conduzindo discovery, levantamento de requisitos e desenho de soluções end to end.
  • Construir propostas técnico-comerciais, decks executivos e materiais de apoio para conversas com C-level e áreas de negócio do cliente.
  • Conduzir reuniões client facing, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em arquitetura de solução viável e financeiramente saudável.
  • Conectar áreas internas (delivery, parceiros, especialistas e fornecedores) para construir respostas integradas dentro dos prazos comerciais.
  • Acompanhar tendências de mercado e movimentos da concorrência, contribuindo com a evolução do portfólio de ofertas para a vertical.


Necessário:

  • Formação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, TI ou áreas correlatas, preferencialmente com pós-graduação ou MBA em gestão de projetos, transformação digital ou afins.
  • Experiência prévia em consultoria, integradores de TI ou times de pré-vendas, atendendo clientes de grande porte da vertical industrial (óleo e gás, manufatura, utilities ou energia).
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, SAFe) e gestão de projetos, com vivência prática em ambientes de delivery complexo.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de análise de dados (Power BI, SQL) e leitura técnica de soluções de tecnologia.
  • Inglês avançado para interlocução com fornecedores, parceiros e times globais.
  • Postura consultiva, clareza de comunicação, velocidade na produção de materiais e energia para conectar pessoas e conduzir o ambiente.


Diferencial:

  • Certificações como Professional Scrum Master, SAFe Agilist, PMP ou similares.
  • Experiência em projetos de transformação digital em ambientes industriais ou cadeias produtivas afins.
  • Vivência prévia com clientes do setor de M&M, Auto/Equipamentos, CPG/Agri, Oil and Gas e Manufatura Avançada.

title: Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About the Opportunity:

As a Solutions Architect specialized in Data & AI, you will be responsible for driving business growth, expanding our market share, and accelerating our strategic partnership with Google Cloud.


This is a highly strategic, technical-commercial role. You will act as the trusted advisor for our clients, identifying new business opportunities, understanding complex business challenges, and architecting customized Google Cloud Data & AI solutions. Your ultimate goal is to bridge the gap between technical excellence and business value, presenting high-impact pitches to C-level executives to close deals and maximize Google Cloud adoption.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Business Development & Pipeline Growth: Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities for Data and Generative AI solutions within our Google Cloud ecosystem.
  • Google Partnership Alignment: Work closely with Google Cloud’s internal sales and technical teams (Partner Managers, Account Executives, and CE/CEs) to co-sell, align strategies, and map target accounts.
  • Executive Pitching & Value Selling: Lead discovery sessions and deliver compelling technical-commercial pitches to C-Level executives (CDO, CIO, CTO, CMO), translating complex technical architectures into clear business outcomes, ROI, and strategic value.
  • Solution Architecture & Prototyping: Design high-level, customized data architectures and coordinate rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs) on Google Cloud to validate value and accelerate the client’s buying decision.
  • Proposal & RFP Leadership: Own the technical-commercial strategy for complex proposals and RFPs, defining the scope, commercial engineering, and value proposition of the proposed Google Cloud solution.
  • Advanced English


Required Qualifications:

  • Proven BDM or Technical Pre-Sales Experience: Solid track record in Business Development, Technical Sales, or Solution Architecture within the IT/Cloud Consulting industry, specifically driving cloud revenue.
  • Google Cloud Ecosystem Expertise: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud's data portfolio (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Dataflow).
  • AI & Generative AI Acumen: Solid understanding of Google Cloud’s AI capabilities (Vertex AI, Model Garden, Gemini API), and how to position them to solve real-world business problems.
  • C-Level Communication & Storytelling: Outstanding communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and influence decision-makers at the executive level.
  • Commercial Strategy: Ability to structure complex deals, build business cases focused on ROI, and understand consumption-based cloud business models.
  • Data Strategy Knowledge: Strong understanding of modern data paradigms, such as Data Lakes, Data Governance, Data Mesh, and how data readiness impacts AI success.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Google Cloud Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or Digital Leader certifications are a strong differentiator.
  • Partner Ecosystem Experience: Prior experience working within the Google Cloud partner ecosystem or directly at Google.
  • Technical Background: Previous hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Data Scientist is a plus, ensuring high technical credibility with clients' engineering teams.


Work Environment:

  • A fast-paced, high-growth environment focused on innovation and results.
  • High visibility, working directly with strategic clients and global tech leaders (Google).
  • Direct impact on the company’s revenue growth and strategic partnership status.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Annotation & Review Specialist(Polish)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Annotation & Review Specialist(Polish) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


About the Role


Job Title: Annotation & Review Specialist

Employment Type: Freelance / Project-Based

Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Work Hours: Flexible; minimum commitment of 4–5 hours per day

Eligibility: Open to candidates with a High school or above degree

Language Required : Polish



We are seeking for detail-oriented and quality-focused individuals to join our team as Annotation & Review Specialists. This is a freelance, remote opportunity that offers flexible working hours.

The role involves understanding cultural and linguistic nuances, reviewing and annotating data, and following detailed project-specific guidelines to enhance AI performance and accuracy.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform annotation tasks on images and videos as per project guidelines.
  • Review annotated images and video content to ensure accuracy and quality standards are met.
  • Provide clear and constructive feedback on annotations and identify areas requiring correction or improvement.
  • Follow project instructions, workflows, and timelines consistently.
  • Maintain high attention to detail while handling large volumes of data.
  • Collaborate with the quality and project teams to improve annotation accuracy and efficiency.



Required Skills & Qualifications


  • High school or Bachelor’s degree in mandatory.
  • Ability to understand and follow detailed annotation guidelines.
  • Basic computer proficiency and familiarity with online tools/platforms.
  • Prior experience in annotation, data labeling, or quality review is an added advantage.


What Makes This Role Exciting


  • Fully remote opportunity , allowing you to work comfortably from home.
  • Flexible working hours (4–5 hours per day) to suit your schedule.
  • The chance to contribute to cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) training initiatives , shaping the future of language technology.


Note:

For this role, you are required to complete the Internal assessment and English assessment within two (2) days from the date it is assigned to you.

title: Intermediate Financial and Cost Mgmt Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Intermediate Financial and Cost Mgmt Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ensure financial planning, cost control, and financial governance for Platform / Technology areas.


Core responsibilities

  • Manage the receipt, validation, and follow-up of invoices, with strong focus on critical vendors.
  • Support the monthly LE (Latest Estimate) process covering CAPEX, OPEX, and People.
  • Maintain and update internal financial controls, including budget, POs, GRs, GRNI, and invoices.
  • Analyze financial performance and deviations, including FY impact, expected vs. actual cost validation, and cost allocation accuracy.
  • Validate travel cost classifications to ensure proper reporting.
  • Support the preparation of monthly financial analyses to senior leadership.
  • Support the One Year Plan (1YP) process.


What you'll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Economics, Engineering, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields.
  • Advanced proficiency in the Office Suite, with an emphasis on Excel.
  • Knowledge of Power BI and Anaplan will be considered an advantage.
  • High proficiency in English (Fluent) and Portuguese (Fluent).


Sof Skills:

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work closely with stakeholders from various departments, ensuring all necessary alignments for project delivery.
  • Strong documentation and organizational skills.
  • Organized profile, capable of working autonomously while being willing to seek help when needed.
  • Ownership of the processes end-to-end.
  • Accountability of the reports delivered.

O que nos move é a transformação e nosso lema é criar caminhos além do imaginável! Isso nos torna BeFly. E aí, você vem com a gente?


#VemSerBeFly


Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para atuar como referência funcional e evolutiva do ERP Benner Turismo, garantindo estabilidade operacional, evolução do produto e alinhamento entre negócio, tecnologia e fornecedores. Papel híbrido, com forte atuação como Product Owner, priorizando backlog, melhorias e entregas de valor.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Ser o ponto focal do ERP Benner (módulos financeiros, faturamento, conciliação, backoffice e integrações).

  • Levantar e traduzir necessidades do negócio em requisitos funcionais claros.
  • Conduzir refinamentos, homologações e apoiar testes (UAT).
  • Garantir qualidade das entregas, estabilidade e aderência aos processos do negócio.
  • Interface direta com áreas usuárias, fornecedores (Benner) e times técnicos.
  • Apoiar projetos de automação, melhorias contínuas e integrações (APIs, arquivos, RPA).
  • Monitorar indicadores, riscos e impactos operacionais.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida com ERP Benner (preferencialmente Benner Turismo).
  • Vivência em áreas financeiras/administrativas e processos de backoffice.
  • Atuação prévia ou forte aderência ao papel de Product Owner.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e capacidade de priorização.
  • Perfil hands-on, colaborativo e orientado a entrega.
  • Experiência com projetos, backlog, indicadores e condução de demandas com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Desejável conhecimento em Power BI, integrações e automação de processos


Quais os benefícios de ser BeFly?


  • VR iFood Benefícios | Para que você se alimente bem.

  • Seguro de vida | Sem custo para o colaborador.
  • Assistência odontológica | OdontoPrev.
  • Wellhub | Para você cuidar da sua saúde física.
  • Day off de aniversário | Um dia de descanso no seu aniversário.
  • Programa de maternidade | Pacote com diversos cuidados para uma gestação tranquila.
  • Programa Oriente-me | Sessões de terapia sem custo adicional.
  • Estacionamento na sede | Desconto exclusivo para colaboradores.
  • Convênios educacionais | Descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras.
  • BeFlyers Travel | Agência de lazer interna com condições especiais para colaboradores.

title: DataOps Engineer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para DataOps Engineer (Relocation to Portugal) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems. With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation. Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Minimum 2/3 years of experience as a DataOps Engineer;
  • Hands-on experience creating, automating, and maintaining data pipelines;
  • Experience working with DevOps practices and cloud environments;
  • English level B2 or higher;
  • Availability to relocate to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!


If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .


The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.


About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.


You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.



Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.


Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.
  • Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits.
  • Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma.
  • Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar).
  • Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar).
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique.
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus.
  • Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Senior Specialist, Global ICSR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Specialist, Global ICSR em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Title: Senior Specialist, Global ICSR Case Processing & QC

Department: Global Patient Safety


Overview:

Seeking an experienced Senior Specialist in Global ICSR Case Processing & QC to independently manage the processing and quality control of individual case safety reports (ICSRs), ensuring regulatory compliance and excellence in data accuracy, completeness, and quality. The role includes SAE reconciliation, meeting compliance and productivity targets, and supporting onboarding and training for new team members.


Key Responsibilities:

  • ICSR Case Processing: Manage case processing and quality control of ICSRs from diverse sources (e.g., clinical trials, post-market, literature) to ensure timely, accurate submissions to regulatory authorities.
  • SAE Reconciliation: Perform SAE reconciliations between safety and clinical databases, track progress, resolve issues, and escalate when necessary.
  • Quality & Compliance: Adhere to KPI and quality metrics, ensuring productivity and process improvement within ICSR management.
  • Decision-Making: Execute decisions in line with operational policies, SOPs, and work instructions.
  • Vendor/CRO Coordination: Ensure ICSR activities align with PV agreements and contracts.
  • Training & Onboarding: Develop and update training materials, onboard new team members, provide feedback, and support the onboarding process.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, clinical medicine, nursing, pharmacy, or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred.
  • Proficiency with Argus safety database and MS Office Suite.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in drug safety/pharmacovigilance or relevant clinical experience. Preferred 5-8 years of experience
  • Strong understanding of global regulatory requirements (e.g., ICH, FDA, EMA, MHRA) for pharmacovigilance reporting.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, time management, and attention to detail.
  • Global cultural awareness and collaborative mindset.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.


About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.


You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.



Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.


Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.
  • Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits.
  • Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma.
  • Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar).
  • Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar).
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique.
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus.
  • Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

description:

Title: Senior Specialist, Global ICSR Case Processing & QC

Department: Global Patient Safety


Overview:

Seeking an experienced Senior Specialist in Global ICSR Case Processing & QC to independently manage the processing and quality control of individual case safety reports (ICSRs), ensuring regulatory compliance and excellence in data accuracy, completeness, and quality. The role includes SAE reconciliation, meeting compliance and productivity targets, and supporting onboarding and training for new team members.


Key Responsibilities:

  • ICSR Case Processing: Manage case processing and quality control of ICSRs from diverse sources (e.g., clinical trials, post-market, literature) to ensure timely, accurate submissions to regulatory authorities.
  • SAE Reconciliation: Perform SAE reconciliations between safety and clinical databases, track progress, resolve issues, and escalate when necessary.
  • Quality & Compliance: Adhere to KPI and quality metrics, ensuring productivity and process improvement within ICSR management.
  • Decision-Making: Execute decisions in line with operational policies, SOPs, and work instructions.
  • Vendor/CRO Coordination: Ensure ICSR activities align with PV agreements and contracts.
  • Training & Onboarding: Develop and update training materials, onboard new team members, provide feedback, and support the onboarding process.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, clinical medicine, nursing, pharmacy, or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred.
  • Proficiency with Argus safety database and MS Office Suite.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in drug safety/pharmacovigilance or relevant clinical experience. Preferred 5-8 years of experience
  • Strong understanding of global regulatory requirements (e.g., ICH, FDA, EMA, MHRA) for pharmacovigilance reporting.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, time management, and attention to detail.
  • Global cultural awareness and collaborative mindset.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.


About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.


You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.



Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.


Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.
  • Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits.
  • Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma.
  • Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar).
  • Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar).
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique.
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus.
  • Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Recruiter (Fluent English)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Recruiter (Fluent English) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Recruiter - Fluent in English | Remote


(POSITION TO AT LEAST 2 YEAR EXPERIENCED RECRUITER)


At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for an experienced and strategic Executive Recruiter to lead end-to-end hiring processes and support corporate talent acquisition for international clients.

This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build a long-term career in Talent Acquisition and HR leadership.


What We Offer


  • Compensation of R$5,000 + bonuses in USD
  • 100% remote, working directly with U.S. teams
  • Monday to Friday, 12PM – 21 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term position
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (Senior Recruiter, Lead, Manager)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Structured training and continuous coaching


Your Responsibilities


  • Manage full-cycle recruitment for corporate and strategic roles
  • Partner with stakeholders to align candidate profiles and hiring needs
  • Source, screen, and interview candidates for the U.S. market
  • Utilize tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS platforms
  • Manage and maintain healthy candidate pipelines
  • Ensure an excellent candidate experience end-to-end
  • Maintain consistent communication with hiring managers and candidates
  • Support strategic hiring initiatives for clients and internal teams


What We’re Looking For


  • 2+ year of experience with Recruitment/Hunting in the American market
  • Proven experience in end-to-end recruitment
  • Strong English communication skills (professional level)
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple requisitions
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments


Nice to Have


  • Background in corporate or executive recruitment
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS
  • Experience in high-volume or fast-paced hiring environments
  • Experience working with global stakeholders
  • Experience recruiting for international or U.S. clients is a strong plus



Technical Requirements


  • Two monitors
  • Laptop with i5/i7 (or equivalent) + 12GB RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone
  • Quiet home office


Build your international career in Recruitment.


Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Data Focused)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Support Engineer (Data Focused) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company & Product

Our client is a Business Intelligence platform enabling customers to connect multiple data sources (e.g., Excel, SQL) into a unified environment, build interactive dashboards, apply formulas, and customize via plugins, scripts, and embedding. The product supports both SaaS and on-prem deployments. Support is organized into 4 pods: Analytics, DevEx, Data, and Infra.


About Role and Team:

As a Technical Support Engineer you will work with leading enterprise organizations and startups to realize the power of data analytics. Our Technical Support team spans the globe and has recently begun a major transformation effort to move to a SWARM model for our tools, processes, and organizational structure. This shift focuses on driving a collaborative, rewarding environment that measures value creation and team playing. Our team is aligned directly with our Product and Engineering teams through a robust Subject Matter Expert program.


Responsibilities:

● Investigate technical problems and diagnose root causes in Linux and Windows servers

● Develop, design, and propose solutions to meet the technological and business needs of customers (e.g. workarounds for product issues and additional features)

● Manage critical issues that impact customer’s business

● Work with R&D and Product teams to meet customer requirements and improve our product

● Present complex technical information about the product to the customers

● Take part in the creation and maintenance of our knowledge-based and community

● Work with Linux shell, RestAPI, Web applications troubleshooting, application installations, identifying process improvements, debugging, comprehending technical documents


Work Hours : US East business hours.


Main Skills (What You’ve Already Accomplished...So Far):

● You already experienced with supporting complex product infrastructure and applications

● You have experience with troubleshooting web applications

● You have experience with databases such as MS SQL, MySQL, Oracle etc, SQL scripting at least at basic level

● You already worked with ETL and BI tools such as Microsoft Power BI, Talend, SSRS, BusinessObjects, Cognos etc OR you are able to write and understand complex formulas

● You have experience working with logs, and various monitoring tools such as Grafana, New Relic, Kibana

● You are familiar with cloud infrastructure AWS

● You have experience in communication with English-speaking customers


Nice to have:

● Web development background and/or programming familiarity ( specifically Python)

● Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or Hadoop

● Experience with RestAPI

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Support Engineer (Data Focused) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company & Product

Our client is a Business Intelligence platform enabling customers to connect multiple data sources (e.g., Excel, SQL) into a unified environment, build interactive dashboards, apply formulas, and customize via plugins, scripts, and embedding. The product supports both SaaS and on-prem deployments. Support is organized into 4 pods: Analytics, DevEx, Data, and Infra.


About Role and Team:

As a Technical Support Engineer you will work with leading enterprise organizations and startups to realize the power of data analytics. Our Technical Support team spans the globe and has recently begun a major transformation effort to move to a SWARM model for our tools, processes, and organizational structure. This shift focuses on driving a collaborative, rewarding environment that measures value creation and team playing. Our team is aligned directly with our Product and Engineering teams through a robust Subject Matter Expert program.


Responsibilities:

● Investigate technical problems and diagnose root causes in Linux and Windows servers

● Develop, design, and propose solutions to meet the technological and business needs of customers (e.g. workarounds for product issues and additional features)

● Manage critical issues that impact customer’s business

● Work with R&D and Product teams to meet customer requirements and improve our product

● Present complex technical information about the product to the customers

● Take part in the creation and maintenance of our knowledge-based and community

● Work with Linux shell, RestAPI, Web applications troubleshooting, application installations, identifying process improvements, debugging, comprehending technical documents


Work Hours : US East business hours.


Main Skills (What You’ve Already Accomplished...So Far):

● You already experienced with supporting complex product infrastructure and applications

● You have experience with troubleshooting web applications

● You have experience with databases such as MS SQL, MySQL, Oracle etc, SQL scripting at least at basic level

● You already worked with ETL and BI tools such as Microsoft Power BI, Talend, SSRS, BusinessObjects, Cognos etc OR you are able to write and understand complex formulas

● You have experience working with logs, and various monitoring tools such as Grafana, New Relic, Kibana

● You are familiar with cloud infrastructure AWS

● You have experience in communication with English-speaking customers


Nice to have:

● Web development background and/or programming familiarity ( specifically Python)

● Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or Hadoop

● Experience with RestAPI

title: Oracle GoldenGate Data Engineer | Senior (Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Oracle GoldenGate Data Engineer | Senior (Remote) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Projetar, desenvolver e sustentar pipelines de dados escaláveis com foco em ingestão via CDC (Change Data Capture) utilizando Oracle GoldenGate;
  • Configurar e administrar replicações de dados em tempo real e quase tempo real entre sistemas origem e ambientes cloud;
  • Garantir consistência, integridade e sincronização dos dados entre origem e destino;
  • Monitorar pipelines de ingestão, atuar em troubleshooting e otimizar performance dos processos CDC;
  • Suportar estratégias de carga full e incremental (delta load);
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de processamento de dados utilizando Azure e Databricks (Spark);
  • Implementar transformações seguindo arquitetura moderna de dados no modelo Bronze, Silver e Gold;
  • Otimizar pipelines visando performance, escalabilidade e eficiência de custos;
  • Trabalhar com dados estruturados e semiestruturados para consumo analítico, relatórios e iniciativas de IA/ML;
  • Atuar em conjunto com arquitetos de dados na definição de arquiteturas modernas de Lakehouse;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de governança, catálogo de dados, lineage e compliance;
  • Garantir disponibilidade, confiabilidade, segurança e qualidade dos dados para consumo downstream.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prática e sólida com Oracle GoldenGate em processos de ingestão de dados e CDC (Change Data Capture), incluindo replicação em tempo real e quase tempo real;
  • Vivência no desenvolvimento, sustentação e otimização de pipelines de dados escaláveis e distribuídos;
  • Experiência com ecossistema Microsoft Azure, incluindo Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake e Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2;
  • Forte conhecimento em Databricks e processamento distribuído utilizando Spark;
  • Experiência em arquiteturas modernas de dados, como Lakehouse, trabalhando com camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold;
  • Vivência com cargas full e incrementais (delta load), garantindo integridade, consistência e sincronização dos dados;
  • Conhecimento em monitoramento de pipelines, troubleshooting, tuning de performance e otimização de custos em ambientes cloud;
  • Experiência com dados estruturados e semiestruturados voltados para analytics, reporting e iniciativas de IA/ML;
  • Conhecimento em governança de dados, catálogo, lineage, segurança e boas práticas de arquitetura corporativa;
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos de dados, times analíticos e stakeholders de negócio.

title: Vacation Rental Revenue Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vacation Rental Revenue Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're hiring a detail-oriented, numbers-driven Vacation Rental Revenue Manager to help Emperor Rentals improve pricing, occupancy, and revenue across our short-term rental portfolio.


This is a fully remote position for candidates currently based in Brazil. You'll work with property performance data, market trends, and pricing tools to help us make smarter revenue decisions every week.


Compensation:

$250 USD per week, paid weekly.


What you'll do:

- Review property performance, pricing, occupancy, ADR, and revenue trends

- Help optimize nightly rates based on seasonality, demand, events, and competitor pricing

- Build and maintain simple revenue reports and forecasts

- Track KPIs and identify opportunities to increase profitability

- Support pricing decisions across Airbnb, short-term rental, and vacation rental channels

- Communicate insights clearly and help the team make data-backed decisions


You may be a great fit if you:

- Are currently based in Brazil and can work remotely

- Are highly analytical, organized, and comfortable working with numbers

- Have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Can spot patterns in data and turn them into practical recommendations

- Are detail-oriented, reliable, and proactive

- Communicate clearly and can work independently

- Are interested in hospitality, Airbnb, short-term rentals, real estate, finance, or revenue management


Nice to have:

- Experience with Airbnb, vacation rentals, hotels, property management, or revenue management

- Experience with pricing tools, market research, dashboards, or financial reporting

- Background in business, finance, economics, analytics, hospitality, or a related field


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys data, pricing strategy, and helping a growing vacation rental company make smarter decisions. If you're based in Brazil and want a remote role where your analysis directly affects business results, we'd love to hear from you.


To apply, please include:

- Your resume

- A short note about your relevant experience

- Your LinkedIn profile, if available

  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.

  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.

  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

title: Vacation Rental Revenue Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vacation Rental Revenue Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're hiring a detail-oriented, numbers-driven Vacation Rental Revenue Manager to help Emperor Rentals improve pricing, occupancy, and revenue across our short-term rental portfolio.


This is a fully remote position for candidates currently based in Brazil. You'll work with property performance data, market trends, and pricing tools to help us make smarter revenue decisions every week.


Compensation:

$250 USD per week, paid weekly.


What you'll do:

- Review property performance, pricing, occupancy, ADR, and revenue trends

- Help optimize nightly rates based on seasonality, demand, events, and competitor pricing

- Build and maintain simple revenue reports and forecasts

- Track KPIs and identify opportunities to increase profitability

- Support pricing decisions across Airbnb, short-term rental, and vacation rental channels

- Communicate insights clearly and help the team make data-backed decisions


You may be a great fit if you:

- Are currently based in Brazil and can work remotely

- Are highly analytical, organized, and comfortable working with numbers

- Have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Can spot patterns in data and turn them into practical recommendations

- Are detail-oriented, reliable, and proactive

- Communicate clearly and can work independently

- Are interested in hospitality, Airbnb, short-term rentals, real estate, finance, or revenue management


Nice to have:

- Experience with Airbnb, vacation rentals, hotels, property management, or revenue management

- Experience with pricing tools, market research, dashboards, or financial reporting

- Background in business, finance, economics, analytics, hospitality, or a related field


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys data, pricing strategy, and helping a growing vacation rental company make smarter decisions. If you're based in Brazil and want a remote role where your analysis directly affects business results, we'd love to hear from you.


To apply, please include:

- Your resume

- A short note about your relevant experience

- Your LinkedIn profile, if available

title: Técnico de Automação
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Técnico de Automação em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Executar manutenções em sistemas de automação com CLPs, redes industriais e dispositivos de campo.
  • Realizar calibração e manutenção de instrumentos de medição (ex: temperatura, pressão, vazão, nível).
  • Atuar em instrumentação analítica, realizando ajustes e testes em campo.
  • Executar rotas de inspeção técnica, preenchendo checklists e registros técnicos.
  • Participar de paradas de máquina, colaborando nas intervenções de automação.
  • Parametrizar e testar inversores, IHMs e controladores diversos.
  • Apoiar o detalhamento técnico de atividades junto ao planejamento.
  • Contribuir com a matriz de criticidade dos ativos de automação.
  • Participar das reuniões diárias (daily management), contribuindo com informações técnicas.Realizar as atividades da sua função conforme as normas técnicas, procedimentos da qualidade, limpeza, organização, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente.
  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas às descritas acima, compatível com a sua condição pessoal e conforme solicitado pelo seu superior imediato.


Requisitos:

  • Curso Técnico Completo em Automação, Mecatrônica, Eletroeletrônica ou áreas Correlatas.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar de forma presencial em Feira de Santana-BA.
  • Experiência em Automação, preferencialmente em indústria.
  • Vivência com CLPs, IHMs, inversores, instrumentação industrial, Calibração e ajuste de instrumentos.
  • Conhecimento em Redes industriais (ex: Profibus, Ethernet/IP), em Leitura de diagramas de automação.
  • Conhecimento em Sistema ERP (ex.: SAP) e sistemas de gestão de manutenção.


Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.


Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.


Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Freelancer | AEM Content Author (Adobe Experience Manager)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Freelancer | AEM Content Author (Adobe Experience Manager) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Buscamos um(a) AEM Content Author responsável pela publicação de conteúdos digitais no Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), garantindo consistência, qualidade e alinhamento com as diretrizes de marca e estratégia digital da empresa.

Esse profissional atuará em conjunto com times de marketing, UX/UI e tecnologia, sendo responsável por assegurar que os conteúdos sejam entregues com excelência, seguindo boas práticas de usabilidade, SEO e governança, além de contribuir para a evolução contínua da operação digital.


PRINCIPAIS ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Criar, editar e publicar páginas, componentes e conteúdos no Adobe Experience Manager (AEM);
  • Gerenciar a estrutura de navegação, organização de páginas, taxonomia e metadados;
  • Garantir a correta aplicação de SEO on-page, acessibilidade e boas práticas de conteúdo;
  • Revisar conteúdos assegurando consistência visual, textual e aderência às diretrizes de marca;
  • Validar o comportamento das páginas em diferentes dispositivos (desktop, tablet e mobile);
  • Apoiar campanhas digitais, lançamentos de produtos e atualizações de conteúdo recorrentes;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de marketing, design, produto e tecnologia;
  • Realizar testes básicos antes da publicação (links, imagens, componentes, navegação);
  • Identificar e reportar inconsistências ou bugs, colaborando com times técnicos na resolução;
  • Apoiar a validação de novos componentes e funcionalidades dentro do AEM;
  • Contribuir para a organização e melhoria contínua dos processos de publicação e governança de conteúdo.

REQUISITOS

  • Experiência comprovada com Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) como Content Author;
  • Conhecimento em estrutura de páginas, templates e componentes no AEM;
  • Noções de HTML e CSS para entendimento de estrutura e ajustes básicos;
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de SEO e acessibilidade;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de design como Figma e Adobe Photoshop;
  • Perfil organizado, com atenção a detalhes e foco em qualidade;
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalhar com times multidisciplinares.


DESEJÁVEL

  • Experiência com ferramentas do ecossistema Adobe, como Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Adobe Launch, Adobe Assets;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise como Google Analytics 4 (GA4) e Google Tag Manager (GTM);
  • Conhecimento em personalização de conteúdo e segmentação de audiência;
  • Experiência com CMS headless ou arquiteturas híbridas;
  • Experiência com CMS Wordpress, Drupal, Joomla ou similares;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de apoio à criação de conteúdo baseadas em AI, como ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly ou assistentes de escrita e otimização de conteúdo;
  • Noções de uso de AI para geração, revisão e otimização de conteúdo (SEO, copy, variações);
  • Experiência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

Pagamento por hora
